name: Beanie - Smile High Club (Two-Sided)
description:
The Smile High Club Beanie brings bold color and clean detailing together in an everyday essential. Designed in a rich safety orange-inspired knit, this beanie features double-sided flat embroidery for a standout look from every angle.

One side features the signature Smile High Club embroidery, while the reverse side is finished with the OCHO logo and smiley face graphic for added detail and versatility.

Built with a soft stretch fit and classic fold-over cuff, it delivers all-day comfort while keeping the styling effortless. Whether paired with a full fit or worn casually, this piece adds the perfect pop of color without overdoing it.

Features:
• Soft stretch knit construction
• Double-sided flat embroidery
• Smile High Club embroidery on front
• OCHO smiley logo embroidery on reverse side
• Fold-over cuff fit
• Safety orange-inspired colorway
• One size fits most
